::: {#exr-which-are-linear}

#### Which of these are affine in $\vec w$?

Each of the five expressions is a function of the weights
$\vec w \in \mathbb{R}^p$,
with the data $\vec x$ and $y$ held fixed.
Say which ones are affine (@def-affine-map), that is, have the form @eq-linear-scalar
--- an inner product plus an offset --- and which of those are also linear (@def-linear-map).

1.  $\vec w^\top \vec x$
2.  $\vec w^\top \vec x - y$
3.  $(\vec w^\top \vec x - y)^2$
4.  $\lVert \vec w \rVert_2^2$
5.  $w_1 x_1 + 3$

:::
